title: Florida court overturns order against couple accused of disrupting weddings at a historic mansion
summary_full: In a significant ruling, a Florida appeals court has reversed a previous order aimed at curbing a couple's disruptive activities that allegedly disrupted outdoor wedding ceremonies with loud machinery and gunfire. While the immediate limitations have been lifted, the legal battle persists with potential civil nuisance claims still on the table. The appeals court mandates that any new restrictions must strictly adhere to specific evidence criteria.
